exercises.why: **представлял** — представля́ть (imperfective): to present, to offer; to produce, to show; to introduce, to present; to imagine, to picture, to fancy, to conceive.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station
to stop, to come to a stop, to pause, to pull up
to stop, to bring to stop
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: постоя́нно — constantly, always; ста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station; остана́вливаться — to stop, to come to a stop, to pause, to pull up; останови́ть — to stop, to bring to stop.

**останавливайся** — остана́вливаться (imperfective): to stop, to come to a stop, to pause, to pull up; to put up, to stop, to stay; to dwell on; to decide in favor, to decide on, to settle on. Wiktionary: остана́вливать + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

pairs: to occur, to present itself; to offer, to arise
introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another)
to install, to place, to mount
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: представля́ться — to occur, to present itself; to offer, to arise; постоя́нный — constant, permanent; представле́ние — introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another); установи́ть — to install, to place, to mount.
